name: ag-carry-factor-relationship
description: Does carry predict forward returns in corn and soybeans? Bar chart shows quarterly win rate (QuarterYear). Rolling line shows factor stability. Stats table verifies the edge.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AG CARRY FACTOR STUDY — WIN RATE EXHIBITS
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does carry predict forward returns in corn and soybeans?
# Design:   Bar chart (quarterly win rate) → Rolling win rate (stability) → Stats (verification)
# Assets:   ZC (corn), ZS (soybeans) — the contrast IS the finding
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS FUTURES — carry + adjusted close
# =============================================================================

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry
close = cont.c

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURN (63 trading days ~ 1 quarter)
# =============================================================================

fwd_63d_raw = ((close << 63) - close) / close
fwd_63d = where(close > 0, fwd_63d_raw)

# =============================================================================
# WIN INDICATOR — did carry correctly predict direction?
# carry > 0 (backwardation) + fwd > 0 = correct
# carry <= 0 (contango)     + fwd <= 0 = correct
# =============================================================================

both_valid = is_valid(carry) and is_valid(fwd_63d)
carry_pos = carry > 0
fwd_pos = fwd_63d > 0
carry_neg = carry <= 0
fwd_neg = fwd_63d <= 0
correct = (carry_pos and fwd_pos) or (carry_neg and fwd_neg)
win = where(both_valid, 1.0 if correct else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# TIME COMPONENTS
# =============================================================================

quarter = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.quarter)(index())
year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())

# =============================================================================
# EXHIBIT 1 — QUARTERLY WIN RATE BAR CHART (per-asset)
# xy_bars with agg=Mean aggregates daily win indicators per quarter.
# x_category_type=QuarterYear converts YYYYQ → "Q1 '10", "Q2 '10", etc.
# =============================================================================

quarter_year_label = year * 10 + quarter

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Quarterly Carry Win Rate',
    category='Carry Factor Study',
    y_axis_label='Win Rate',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.QuarterYear,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (No Edge)')
    ]),
    order=0
)(win, label=quarter_year_label)

# =============================================================================
# EXHIBIT 2 — ROLLING WIN RATE LINE (cross-asset)
# Trailing 252-day (1 year) SMA of daily win indicator.
# ZS should hover above 50%. ZC should wobble around it.
# =============================================================================

rolling_wr = ma(period=252)(win)

cs_lines(
    title='Rolling 1-Year Carry Win Rate',
    category='Carry Factor Study',
    y_axis_label='Win Rate',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (No Edge)')
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_idx, rolling_wr)

# =============================================================================
# EXHIBIT 3 — STATS TABLE (cross-sectional: one row per asset)
# cs_summary_table creates rows = [ZC-Futures, ZS-Futures] automatically
# =============================================================================

total_obs = where(both_valid, 1.0)
win_count = where(both_valid and correct, 1.0)
incorrect = (carry_pos and fwd_neg) or (carry_neg and fwd_pos)

# --- Profit Factor & Expected Value ---
abs_fwd = abs(fwd_63d)
gross_win = where(both_valid and correct, abs_fwd)
gross_loss = where(both_valid and incorrect, abs_fwd)

# cumulative(Sum) outputs NaN when input is NaN, so ffill through the tail
cum_win = ffill()(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(gross_win))
cum_loss = ffill()(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(gross_loss))
cum_n = ffill()(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(total_obs))

# PF = gross wins / gross losses (>1.0 = edge)
profit_factor = cum_win / cum_loss
# EV = avg per-trade payoff: (total_correct - total_incorrect) / n_trades
ev = (cum_win - cum_loss) / cum_n

cs_summary_table(
    title='Carry Prediction Statistics',
    category='Carry Factor Study',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Carry Prediction Statistics',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Observations', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Win Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Wins', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Profit Factor', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Per-Trade Payoff', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(total_obs, win, win_count, profit_factor, ev)
